name: duplicate_invoice_checker
description: Use this tool to verify if a specific invoice number from a specific vendor already exists in the historical database. Always use this to prevent double-paying an invoice.
schema: [{"id":1,"property":"invoice_no","type":"string","description":"The invoice number from the Supplier_Invoices table","required":true},{"id":2,"property":"vendor_id","type":"string","description":"The unique vendor ID from the Supplier_Invoices table","required":true},{"id":3,"property":"historical_matches","type":"number","description":"The count of times this exact invoice_no and vendor_id combination appears in the database","required":true}]
